name: Quest Journal
description: A player-facing read model of active, ready, completed, and failed quests with current-stage and per-objective progress. Quest Log remains the sole authority for acceptance, transitions, completion, failure, and rewards; Quest Tracker remains the compact pinned HUD; Narrative Journal remains the home for clues and learned lore. This component owns journal filtering, selection, ordering, and unread presentation only. Removing it changes no quest or reward state.

inputs.name: maxQuests
inputs.description: Maximum projected quest entries retained for display. This is a presentation window, not deletion from Quest Log.

inputs.name: showOptionalObjectives
inputs.description: Whether optional objectives appear alongside required stage progress.

inputs.name: sortOrder
inputs.description: Display ordering only; it never changes quest transition priority.

outputs.name: quests
outputs.description: Filtered read-only entries as {questId, title, state, stageId, objectives, completionId}.

outputs.name: activeQuests
outputs.description: Active and ready entries, including their current-stage progress.

outputs.name: selectedQuest
outputs.description: The currently expanded read-only entry, or null.

outputs.name: unreadCount
outputs.description: Changed entries not yet seen since the journal was last opened.

provenance: Added for the RPG Quest & Dialogue Core pack after searching progression.quest_log, ui.quest_tracker, ui.narrative_journal, and ui.dialogue_box. Quest Log owns the underlying state, Quest Tracker owns a small pinned HUD, and Narrative Journal owns discovered clues rather than quest history. The distinct boundary is a removable active/completed/failed quest-browser projection with filtering, selection, and unread presentation; it duplicates no progression or narrative authority.
